extractedItems.title: What happens if you find your original ball on the course?
extractedItems.question: You hit a provisional ball, but then find your original ball on the course (not out of bounds) within 3 minutes. What should you do next?

choices.text: Continue playing the provisional ball
Pick up the provisional ball and play the original ball
Play whichever ball is in a better position
Play both balls and choose the best result

extractedItems.explanation: You must abandon the provisional ball and continue playing with your original ball. Strokes made with the provisional ball do not count.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer picking up her provisional ball after finding her original ball on the fairway.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teenage girl golfer on the fairway picking up a second ball, original ball in play.

extractedItems.title: Original ball found but is unplayable
extractedItems.question: You find your original ball within 3 minutes, but it is stuck against a tree and unplayable. Can you play the provisional ball instead?

choices.text: Yes, you can play the provisional ball instead of the original
No, you must continue with the original ball and use the unplayable ball rule
Yes, but only with a penalty stroke
You can declare both balls lost and replay your shot

extractedItems.explanation: You have to continue with your original ball, even if it's unplayable. You must then use the unplayable ball rule.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer looking at his ball stuck under tree roots, deciding what to do.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer with golf ball stuck by a tree root, thinking about his next move.

extractedItems.title: What if your original ball is out of bounds or not found?
extractedItems.question: You play a provisional ball. Your original ball is later found to be out of bounds, or you don't find it within 3 minutes. What happens now?

choices.text: The provisional ball becomes your ball in play, with a 1-stroke penalty
You must replay your shot from the previous spot with no penalty
You can choose to play either ball with no penalty
You must drop a new ball where the original went out of bounds, with a 2-stroke penalty

extractedItems.explanation: If your original ball is out of bounds or not found within 3 minutes, your provisional ball is now in play with a 1-stroke penalty.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer standing at the edge of the fairway, looking at the out-of-bounds markers, holding a golf club.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teenage boy golfer at the edge of the course looking towards white out-of-bounds markers.
